Scholarship overview

Wellington's Research Mobilisation Doctoral Scholarship supports research with a mobilisation focus. It is a defined university funding route for eligible New Zealand citizens and residents, with selection governed by the scholarship conditions and the proposed doctoral work.

Research Areas

  • Research mobilisation
  • Doctoral research
  • Knowledge exchange

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 32,000/year plus domestic tuition

About Victoria University of Wellington

Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington offers doctoral research through its schools and faculties. Its scholarship routes include research mobilisation funding with specific residency and project requirements.
